text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I l-lost. But...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I got to finish in second place after
Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha, indeed you have!
Together we
are an impenetrable
barricade, we will seal away
the Ultimate
Generation.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah. Umm... By the way, Opera O...
what did
you think?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Was I shining, even just a bit?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why, yes, though it would be farcical to
say it
was perfect. You must compound
your
experiences, Doto, for your
spangles to reach full
glimmer.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-understood. Then, um, next...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I hope to see you at the autumn Tenno
Sho!
There, I'll really shine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice a familiar face in the stands,
watching the
duo intently. I make my
way over.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, it's you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Those two have truly reached their full
potential.
Don't you think so, after
seeing today's race?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But reaching your full potential
isn't all
sunshine and rainbows. There's
nowhere up after
that.
choice_data_list: ...I was just thinking. You've gotten so strong.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even an idiot could see that Opera O's
max stats
are slightly higher.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If they keep competing with each other,
Doto'll
keep losing. It might not be by a
huge margin, but
she won't be able to
close the gap.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And that's not all...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh Spe, isn't it a wonderful day?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It sure is, Grass! That race was honestly
something
else.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have to agree. All this time, the
younger
generation had been so hard at
work. I suppose
it's too early to think
about retiring.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let's pray for the best—to see them
once more at
the year-end Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In the meantime, I'll steel my body and
mind. My
sharpened skills will put even
the finest blades to
shame.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You're s-scaring me a little, Grass.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But I get where you're coming from!
Doto and
Opera O are really good, so
we'll have to be even
better!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There are some crazy runners out
there—with
stats so damn high, I can't
get a read on them.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's why they call them the Ultimate

Generation. Even I'm unsure what they're
capable
of.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Doto's in for a lot of pain. She'll be stuck
up
against the ceiling, struggling to push
past it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's talking about stat ceilings again,
but does a
limit like that really exist?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next race will be the autumn Tenno
Sho. We
need to have a working
strategy by then, if her
words prove to
be true.
